'''Joey Frieda''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2000 Los Gatos tournament]] on 21 October 2000 with [[They Have No Idea We're Coming / Until We Win, Or The Chances Are Spent|TIGIH (copy of the author's deck)]], according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1388">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-26-lg-sj-super-saturday-10-21-00d1388/ lg-sj-super-saturday-10-21-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 26 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-26-lg-sj-super-saturday-10-21-00d1388/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
